description: This file defines a template class 'BinaryInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, providing an interface for sending messages and setting message handlers over WebSocket connections, with some default behaviors and restrictions.

classes.name: BinaryInterface
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket binary message sending and handler setup functionalities, designed to be inherited by concrete implementations.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message by invoking the derived class's 'send' method.

methods.name: setOnMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming messages.
